limit.description: Max number of names to return. Defaults to 100; maximum 1000.

service.description: Comma-separated services to narrow the list to, e.g. `service=web,worker`. Omit for every service. Send it empty to select only series whose sender did not set `service.name`. A service name containing a comma cannot be selected.

value.description: Substring filter (case-insensitive) applied to metric names.
